tool_action.public_message: No deal. Reading + $150 still doesn’t price in the monopoly leverage you’re trying to buy. If you decide you *really* want New York later, come back with a serious premium—otherwise I’m content to sit on it and let the dice do their thing.
tool_action.private_thought: Reject. Keeping New York blocks Claude from an easy Orange setup and preserves my leverage to potentially complete Orange myself if I hit Tennessee later. His ‘final offer’ pressure is a bluff; calling it may induce tilt or push him to overpay elsewhere. I’ll only consider selling NY for an overpay large enough to compensate for enabling his 2/3 Orange and the threat of him buying Tennessee.
